$schema_note: Seed data for the sale-document compliance checklist. NOT LEGAL ADVICE: every rule and threshold marked verify=true must be confirmed by dealer counsel or a CADA/IADAC compliance resource before production use. Rule syntax: {"all":[...]} / {"any":[...]} / {"not":{...}} / {"field":"<path>","op":"<op>","value":<v>}. ops: eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, exists, missing. Fields resolve against the context object described in `context`.

context.vehicle.isMotorcycle: NEW FIELD on Vehicle (or derived from bodyStyle)
context.arrangement.titleState: NEW FIELD: two-letter state the current title was issued in
context.sale.deliveryState: NEW FIELD on SaleTransaction: state where buyer takes physical possession
context.sale.registrationState: NEW FIELD: state the buyer will register in
context.sale.outsideLender: NEW FIELD: boolean, buyer using third-party financing
context.sale.paymentIncludesCashOver10k: derived from Payment rows: method=CASH and sum >= 10000
context.sale.hasAddOns: derived: any optional product/service line items
context.dealer.*: static dealer config (AppSetting): legalName, dba, address, dealerLicenseNo, sellersPermitNo

categories.1: Dealer-authored: app generates from approved template, e-sign eligible
categories.2: Government fillable PDF: app prefills, wet signature, print
categories.3: Controlled DMV document / physical original: app tracks and produces a fill worksheet only
categories.4: Produced by a third party: app collects, attaches, marks complete

signers: BUYER | CO_BUYER | DEALER | CONSIGNOR | LIENHOLDER | NONE

documents.name: Retail Purchase Agreement / Buyer's Order
documents.authority: Dealer document; must carry CARS Act price/add-on disclosures on/after 2026-10-01

versions.note: Adds total-price disclosure, add-on optionality statement (12-pt), cancellation reference

documents.name: Due Bill / We-Owe Agreement
documents.note: Generate a signed 'nothing owed' version when there are no items, so the file always answers the question.

documents.name: FTC Used Car Buyers Guide (window form + signed copy)
documents.note: Must be displayed on the vehicle before sale, not only signed at closing. Motorcycles are outside the FTC rule; verify treatment of pre-1966/kit vehicles.

documents.name: As-Is / Warranty Acknowledgment
documents.note: Optional if the Buyers Guide and purchase agreement already say it. Keep as a template slot; dealer decides.

documents.name: Contract Cancellation Option Agreement (Car Buyer's Bill of Rights)
documents.note: Dealer must OFFER it; buyer may accept or decline. Record the election and any option fee. Two-day window, mileage cap, restocking rules per statute.

documents.name: 3-Day Right to Cancel Used Car Purchase or Lease (CARS Act notice)
documents.sequencing: Consignor settlement may not move to PAYABLE until cancellationWindowEndsAt has passed. Window ends at dealer close of business on the third calendar day after delivery (confirm holiday/weekend handling).
documents.note: Statutory title and content. Do not draft; obtain from counsel/CADA/Reynolds when published.

documents.name: Optional Add-On Product Disclosure (CARS Act)
documents.note: 12-point type, delivered before signing. Rarely triggered for this dealership; keep the rule so it cannot be forgotten.

documents.name: Title Brand / Prior-Use Disclosure (salvage, flood, lemon buyback, prior rental/fleet)
documents.authority: Cal. Veh. Code 11713.26 (NMVTIS brand warning); Civ. Code 1793.23-.24 (buyback)
documents.note: Also requires a red warning sticker on the vehicle while displayed for sale when NMVTIS reports a brand.

documents.name: Buyer Receipt / Transaction Summary
documents.note: Optional per spec. Useful for out-of-state buyers whose DMV asks for proof of tax paid/not paid.

documents.name: Bill of Sale for Buyer's Home-State DMV
documents.note: Some states require notarization. Keep a per-state override table (notary required, own odometer form, title must be signed in ink).

documents.name: Consignment Agreement
documents.timing: INTAKE - must exist before the vehicle is offered for sale; checklist shows it as already-complete or blocking at sale time.

documents.name: Consignor Settlement / Accounting Statement
documents.sequencing: Generated after funds clear and after any cancellation window closes. Deadline tracker uses AppSetting consignorPayoutDays (already configurable).

documents.name: REG 256 - Statement of Facts
documents.note: Signer depends on the statement being made; usually buyer (use tax, smog exemption). Employee should be able to add one manually with a reason.

documents.name: REG 227 - Application for Replacement or Transfer of Title
documents.timing: INTAKE - blocks readiness until resolved. Registered owner (consignor or dealer) signs, not the buyer.
documents.note: If the missing title is from another state, the duplicate must come from that state; flag rather than generate.

documents.name: REG 138 - Notice of Transfer and Release of Liability (consignor)
documents.note: Advisory, not blocking: the dealer's REG 51 submission is what transfers liability. Provide the consignor a prefilled copy or the online link.

documents.name: REG 260 - Power of Attorney
documents.note: Cannot be used to sign the odometer disclosure on the signer's own behalf; REG 262 odometer section still needs the actual transferor.

documents.name: REG 31 - Verification of Vehicle
documents.note: Completed by DMV, CHP, or licensed verifier. Dealers can be licensed vehicle verifiers; app only tracks.

documents.name: CDTFA-448 - Statement of Delivery Outside California
documents.note: Only supports the exemption if the dealer or a common carrier delivers out of state. Buyer pickup in CA = California tax due with the REG 51.

documents.name: IRS Form 8300 - Cash Over $10,000
documents.note: Cash includes cashier's checks/money orders under $10k in some cases. Annual customer statement also required.

documents.name: REG 51 - Report of Sale, Used Vehicle
documents.submitTo: DMV (with fees and sales tax) within statutory window
documents.note: Track the serial number assigned. Buyer copy = temporary registration. Tax remitted to DMV at registration (all used dealers since 2026-01-01).

documents.name: REG 262 - Vehicle/Vessel Transfer and Reassignment Form
documents.note: Serialized security form. On consignment the consignor is transferor; dealer reassigns; buyer is transferee.

documents.name: Original Certificate of Title
documents.submitTo: DMV (or handed to buyer for out-of-state registration)
documents.note: Lienholder signature/release required if a legal owner appears on the title.

documents.name: Federal Odometer Disclosure
documents.note: Model year 2010 and older: exempt. Even when exempt, the sale record must state EXEMPT and mileageStatus must not be UNKNOWN at contract time. mileageStatus is never inferred from year.

documents.name: Temporary Registration / Temporary Plate (eROS / TLP)
documents.note: Issued through the authorized DMV system, not generated. Track TLP number and expiry; out-of-state buyers driving home need it.

documents.name: NMVTIS Vehicle History Report
documents.timing: INTAKE - run before listing; result sets vehicle.titleBrand.
documents.note: Pre-1981 vehicles without a 17-digit VIN often return nothing; record 'no NMVTIS record' with the lookup date.

documents.name: Smog Check Certificate
documents.note: Dealer's obligation on a CA retail sale. Vehicles under 4 model years old pay a smog transfer fee instead. When exempt, record which exemption applied. Valid 90 days.

documents.name: Outside Lender: funding instructions, lienholder info, funding confirmation
documents.note: Lender appears as legal owner on REG 51 and title application; feeds the REG 51 worksheet.

documents.name: Transport / Shipping Documents (bill of lading, delivery receipt)
documents.note: Delivery receipt date starts the CARS Act cancellation clock and supports CDTFA-448. Links to existing TransportJob.

documents.name: Proof of Payment to Consignor
documents.sequencing: Deadline = fundsClearedAt + consignorPayoutDays (AppSetting). Show countdown on vehicle page.

documents.name: Copy of Buyer Government ID
documents.note: Store as signed_docs sensitivity; existing FileObject field grants apply.
